_note: Input to: node tools/music/midi2song.mjs --batch tools/music/songs.json [--preview]. One entry per song file in content/music/. file is relative to _root. Optional overrides: lead/bass/harm (part keys as the report prints them), start/bars (window, in bars), res (steps per beat). year is the original release year and is what the anachronism rule in content/music/playlist.json is checked against. month (required, 1-12) is the release month of the same release: the first release, single or album, whichever came first. _month says where it comes from. A same-year song released after its level's month is a warning in the build log and the Music panel, never a refusal.

songs.title: ONE STEP BEYOND
songs._month: Album One Step Beyond... and its title single, 19 Oct 1979 (Wikipedia: One Step Beyond...; the song's own page gives the single 26 Oct 1979). A cover of Prince Buster's 1964 song: the year and month are Madness's.

songs.title: IMMIGRANT SONG
songs._month: On Led Zeppelin III, 5 Oct 1970 (Wikipedia: Led Zeppelin III); the single followed 5 Nov 1970.

songs.title: BLACK DOG
songs._month: On Led Zeppelin IV, 8 Nov 1971 (Wikipedia: Led Zeppelin IV); the single followed in Dec 1971.

songs.title: BOHEMIAN RHAPSODY
songs._why: the 149bpm operatic section; the MIDI's 420-event tempo map rules out a whole-song window
songs._month: Single released 31 Oct 1975, ahead of the album A Night at the Opera, 21 Nov 1975 (Wikipedia: Bohemian Rhapsody). Both sections of the song share it.

songs.title: D'YER MAK'ER
songs._month: On Houses of the Holy, 28 Mar 1973 (Wikipedia: Houses of the Holy); the single followed in Sep 1973.

songs.title: PEG
songs._month: On Aja, 23 Sep 1977 (Wikipedia: Aja); the single followed in Nov 1977.

songs.title: STAND AND DELIVER
songs._month: Single: Wikipedia now gives 1 May 1981, earlier revisions and mirrors 27 Apr 1981. It entered the UK chart at No. 1 on 3 May 1981, so the earlier date is kept (Wikipedia: Stand and Deliver).

songs.title: JUST CAN'T GET ENOUGH
songs._month: Single released 7 Sep 1981, ahead of the album Speak & Spell, 5 Oct 1981 (Wikipedia: Just Can't Get Enough).

songs.title: DON'T YOU WANT ME
songs._month: On Dare, 16 Oct 1981 (Wikipedia: Dare; one source says 18 Oct); the single followed 27 Nov 1981.

songs.title: HOUSE OF FUN
songs._month: First on the compilation Complete Madness, 23 Apr 1982; the single followed 14 May 1982 (Wikipedia: House of Fun; Madnessography).

songs.title: AFRICA
songs._month: On Toto IV: Wikipedia's infobox gives 29 Mar 1982 (citing FMQB, 12 Mar 1982), most other sources 8 Apr 1982; the earlier is kept. The single followed in mid-1982.

songs.title: RED RED WINE
songs._month: Single released 8 Aug 1983 (Wikipedia: Labour of Love; some sources 20 Aug), ahead of the album, 12 Sep 1983. UB40's recording: Neil Diamond's original is 1967.

songs.title: TAKE ON ME
songs._month: The 1985 re-recording, the hit, was first released 5 Apr 1985 in the UK (Wikipedia: Take On Me). The song was first released in a different recording on 19 Oct 1984 (Norway): the year here is the 1985 recording's, so the month is too.

songs.title: NEVER GONNA GIVE YOU UP
songs._month: Single released 27 Jul 1987, ahead of the album Whenever You Need Somebody, Nov 1987 (Wikipedia: Never Gonna Give You Up).

songs.title: IF YOU LEAVE
songs._month: On the Pretty in Pink soundtrack, 28 Feb 1986; the single followed 21 Apr 1986 (Wikipedia: If You Leave; Pretty in Pink soundtrack).

songs.title: SWEET CHILD O' MINE
songs._month: Single released 3 Jun 1988 in the US (Wikipedia: Sweet Child o' Mine, release history). The song was first on Appetite for Destruction, 21 Jul 1987: the year here is the single's, so the month is too.

songs.title: HERE COMES YOUR MAN
songs._month: On Doolittle, 17-18 Apr 1989 by source (Wikipedia: Doolittle); the single followed in Jun 1989.

songs.title: TWO PRINCES
songs._month: On Pocket Full of Kryptonite, 20 Aug 1991 (Wikipedia: Pocket Full of Kryptonite); the single followed 4 Jan 1993.

songs.title: CANNONBALL
songs._month: Single released 9 Aug 1993, ahead of the album Last Splash, 30 Aug 1993 (Wikipedia: Cannonball).

songs.title: LUMP
songs._month: On the band's debut album, The Presidents of the United States of America, PopLlama, 10 Mar 1995 (Wikipedia: the album); Columbia's reissue followed 25 Jul 1995.

songs.title: COMMON PEOPLE
songs._month: Single released 22 May 1995, ahead of the album Different Class, Oct 1995 (Wikipedia: Common People).

songs.title: REGULATE
songs._month: On the Above the Rim soundtrack, 22 Mar 1994; the single followed in Apr 1994 (Wikipedia: Regulate; Complex).

songs.title: STEAL MY SUNSHINE
songs._why: the tune is split between the guy's and the girl's vocal tracks
songs._month: On the Go soundtrack, 30 Mar 1999 (Wikipedia: Steal My Sunshine); the single followed in Jun-Jul 1999.
